title: Barbie Pink, Grown Up
description: Barbie pink for a grown-up bedroom: a Barbie pajama set, the Barbie LED neon sign, pink crystal Barbie coasters, a Barbie throw, a Barbie canvas tote and hot pink heart sunglasses.
intro: Barbie pink stopped being a little girl colour a long time ago, and this is the proof. A neon sign that glows on the dresser, crystal coasters that look like jewellery, a throw for the end of the bed, a tote big enough for a book and a water bottle, heart sunglasses and the softest pajamas. Six finds, and only one of them is pretending to be practical.

sections.heading: The glow comes first
paragraphs: The Paladone Barbie LED neon sign is the hot pink Barbie script inside a clear box. Put it on a dresser or a shelf and the whole room turns pink at night. It is officially licensed, so it looks exactly like the logo.

sections.heading: The pieces that make it grown up
paragraphs: The Dragon Glassware Barbie coasters are four faceted pink crystal glass coasters in a hot pink holder with the gold Barbie script. They look like jewellery on a nightstand. The Franco Barbie throw is 50 by 70 inches in hot pink with silver Barbie scripts, silhouettes, stars and hearts.

sections.heading: Wear it and carry it
paragraphs: The pajama set is a light pink tee with the grey Barbie script and silhouette, and pink and grey camo pants. It comes in matching family sizes from little kid to adult, so check the size chart. The MINISO Barbie tote is pink canvas with turquoise handles and the big Barbie script. The heart sunglasses are hot pink with gradient lenses and they are not a Barbie product, just the right pink.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the pajama set, the neon sign, the coasters, the throw, the tote and the sunglasses. The floor, dresser, mirror, bed, bedding, pillows, rug, lemonade, perfume tray, lip glosses, flowers and the dog are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
